name: Mushroom & Olive Stuffed Pizza Burger Wrap with Lemony-Artichoke Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts. Add to the bowl with the dressing, toss to coat, and set aside.
Mince olives and mushrooms; place both in another medium bowl.
Add beef and spices to the bowl with the olives; mix with your hands until well to combined. Form into four, 1-inch thick patties, and place on a plate. Set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, cut tomatoes into thick slices and season on both sides with salt and basil.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add tomatoes and grill until lightly charred, about 1 minute per side. Transfer to a plate.

Place burger patties on the pan and grill, undisturbed, for 5 minutes. Flip patties and top with cheese and grilled tomatoes; continue to grill until cooked through, 5 minutes more. Transfer to the plate used for the tomatoes.
Meanwhile, chop or tear the lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces (reserving two leaves per burger); add to the bowl with the artichokes and toss to combine the salad.
Pile leaves, in stacks of two, onto plates and top with burgers. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
